posts.text:
Would anyone contest a 6-point win? Would anyone say "well, it's not clear who the voters wanted?"

What's *decisive* to you? Obama beat McCain by 7. Decisive? One point move you from "nah" to "decisive?"
posts.summary: Questions what constitutes a decisive election margin

posts.text: I'm thrilled to see this @250to250.bsky.social video posted! I proudly wrote this script, and @radiofreetom.bsky.social's reading is perfect! I spent 15 years working at James A.
